description: This file defines an interface for a generic application logger, abstracting away dependencies on ASP.NET Core logging types. It provides methods for logging informational messages and warnings.

classes.name: IAppLogger<T>
classes.description: A generic interface for application logging, intended to be implemented for custom logging functionality within the application.

methods.name: LogInformation
methods.description: Logs an informational message with optional arguments.

methods.name: LogWarning
methods.description: Logs a warning message with optional arguments.
